title: Defy the Heavens — less violent edit
prompt:
Edit the attached landscape cover to be noticeably LESS BLOODY AND LESS VIOLENT while preserving its identity and dramatic emotional impact. Preserve the exact original landscape framing, primary young adult male cultivator's face and black hairstyle, his upward climbing pose, hands gripping rock, worn ivory-grey layered robes, dark steep chasm, distant luminous heavenly gate and pagodas, perspective, cinematic lighting, richly detailed painterly xianxia style, and LEFT title placement.
REMOVE ALL blood, blood stains, blood spatters, dripping red marks, open cuts and injuries from his face, skin, hands, clothes, rocks, background figures and lettering. Replace with ordinary dust, soot, sweat and weathering; skin is intact, hands anatomically correct. Keep robes worn with moderate frayed edges but less shredded, full modest coverage.
Reduce violence substantially: replace the crowd of screaming corpse-like attackers and all pale hands grabbing his body with layered DARK MIST, flowing abstract shadow and faint distant indistinct silhouettes below him. No recognizable screaming faces, zombies, skeletal bodies, claws or grabbing hands. Nothing physically attacks or touches him. His struggle is climbing out of an oppressive abyss through his own effort. Maintain atmospheric depth and the visual flow of shadows beneath him; do not leave an empty flat bottom.
Retain subtle muted burgundy cloth ribbons and banners as fabric, not blood; remove wet red stains or splashes from them. Existing chains may remain environmental details, not shackles on his body.
Preserve exact title words and original energetic brush-calligraphy arrangement: "Defy the Heavens". Change the blood-red drip/splatter typography accents and surrounding circle to elegant IVORY and restrained ANTIQUE GOLD brush accents, clean dry brush edges with NO blood-like drips or splatter. Keep the title bold and legible, not a different font family.
Keep the protagonist's determined exhausted expression and the striking brightness of the escape above. Mood: perseverance, tension and hope, not graphic horror. Do not add any new text, person, weapon, logo, watermark or border. A faithful targeted edit of THIS image, not a newly composed replacement.
